description.value: Krishna's Dosa Palace is a South Indian restaurant in Surrey specializing in traditional dishes such as Mysore Masala Dosa, Chicken 65 Biryani, idlis, vadas, and parathas, all prepared from time-honored recipes. The menu is notably inclusive, with an extensive range of vegetarian, vegan, and naturally gluten-free options alongside meat dishes. Cyclists passing through the Surrey area can dine in or order ahead online for takeout.
